outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram illustrating camera exposure time vs. illumination overhead as colored bars with calculated percentages; it does not present measured data with a mean that would require individual data points.

Panel B is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves) with shaded mean±s.e.m. bands. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make the curves unreadable.

Panel C shows mean ΔROS values (with error bars) for each light condition connected/fit with a dashed trend line, in a scatter-style plot. Scatter plots are exempt from requiring further overlay of individual replicate points.

Panel D displays line plots of individual single-cell migration tracks (each line represents one migrating cell), so it already shows individual data rather than an aggregated average; no additional overlay is needed.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed per condition with individual cell data points (black dots) overlaid on each bar, satisfying the requirement.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs (MitoTracker, paxillin, merge) with no averaged quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel G is a time-series of micrographs showing paxillin and MitoTracker staining; it contains no averaged data plot.
Panel H is a time-series of micrographs analogous to panel G, with no averaged data plot present.
Panel I is a line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m., n=5). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel J is a line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m., n=5). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
